question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**installed**" means to place or fix (equipment or machinery) in position ready for use. (स्थापित किया हुआ)
 
• In the context of smog towers, being structures that need to be set up for air filtration, **"installed"** is the most suitable word.
 
• The other options: "fabricated," "moulded," and "surmounted" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** The smog towers were installed__ by the Centre under the orders of the Supreme Court of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fabricated (गठन किया हुआ)**: means made or constructed.
 
• **Moulded (ढाला हुआ)**: means shaped.
 
• **Surmounted (पर काबू पाया हुआ)**: means overcome (a difficulty or obstacle) or be placed on top of something.
